source_revision: not-reviewed: provider terms not read; automation surface per Meta's Muse Code documentation (dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code and its extending, permissions, auth, configuration, interactive and changelog pages, retrieved 2026-10-13) and third-party reports, as recorded with a status per row in TDD 4.8 (sources M-ext, M-perm, M-auth, M-cfg, M-int, M-log, M-ov, SDK, Orca) and docs/research/muse-code-2026-10-13.md; no muse binary was installed or run
notes: Added by T4.72 (2026-10-16, Delegated agent work, not owner-approved; fixtures only, no muse was run). The range admits no version (ADR-0009, FR-ADP-09): the adapter fails the version gate with ADAPTER_VERSION_UNVERIFIED until T4.78 runs `switchboard adapters validate muse` against a live CLI after the T4.71 operator capture, so nothing here is a claim that any Muse Code version is validated. Automation surface (TDD 4.8, Proposed): `muse exec --json <flags> <prompt>`, one process per run (exec and --json: M-ext, M-ov, confirmed); `muse --version` for the version (M-ov, confirmed; output format reported only, Orca). Flags emitted, each with its TDD 4.8 source: -w off (Orca, reported; always, the controller owns the worktree), --approval-mode on-request (M-perm, confirmed; the default, passed so the audit sees it), --sandbox-network restricted for network off or unrestricted for network on (M-perm, M-log, corrected), --trust-workspace (M-log; only with repository_config enabled), and the prompt as the last positional word (M-ext). The probe also reads `muse exec --help` for --json, --approval-mode and --sandbox-network. Never emitted: --yolo, --disable-approval, --disable-sandbox (M-perm, M-ext, bypass-class), --approval-mode never, -c/--config, --session-id (resume is T4.73), --prompt-file, --provider, --max-model-steps, --approval-judge, --worktree-existing, --subagent-worktree-isolation, --allow-workspace-switch, --no-session-log. Bypass-class declarations in the registry entry (argv audit, ADR-0035, ADR-0037): --disable-approval, --disable-sandbox and --trust-workspace (--yolo is shared), and the values --approval-mode never, --sandbox-network unrestricted and --sandbox-network enabled (deprecated alias of an unstated value; declared to over-refuse). The shared audit also refuses -w (Cursor's declared short flag) outside an approved privileged bypass run, so a Muse argv spawns only there. Environment: PATH and HOME only; META_API_KEY (M-auth) never reaches the child. MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 is NOT set: it is reported by Orca only, Meta's pages do not mention it, and neither T4.70 nor T4.71 confirmed that it pins the version. Compile matrix (Delegated, fail closed, Grok T4.22 precedent): inspect-untrusted, edit-untrusted, test-sandboxed and trusted-development are Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED) until T4.71 results exist; privileged without bypass is Ineligible (PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED); privileged with an approved bypass scope compiles (owner decision 46) for worktree files, shell broad, network off or on (allowlist is Ineligible), repository_config enabled and no requested model, with approvals and the sandbox left on. Auth (T4.74): no status command is documented (M-auth, M-log); UNKNOWN until then; the login named on AUTH_REQUIRED will be `muse login` (M-log). Parser and resume (T4.73): not yet; a clean exit is OUTPUT_PROTOCOL_ERROR and resume is Ineligible. Git writes (FR-GIT-01, T4.77): no per-command deny control is documented (M-perm), so none-documented; commitChannel finalize-only. Credentials: Switchboard never reads, copies, logs or exports Muse Code credentials, trust or settings files (including ~/.config/muse, reported by Orca), never starts login and never scrapes dashboards (ADR-0003, FR-AUTH-02). Terms: this manifest records that Meta documents headless use (technical evidence only); it makes no claim that any use complies with Meta's terms (NFR-COMP-01). Review date: 2026-10-16 (Delegated agent review, not owner-approved). Linux only; macOS (NFR-PORT-02) and Windows (NFR-PORT-03) are not supported.
